findings.title: Machine Identity Authentication — Gateway Unauthenticated
findings.description: The AgentCore Gateway (primary MCP tool surface) has AuthorizerType: NONE. Any caller that can reach the endpoint can invoke any tool including settlement_writer which moves money. No principal attribution exists in logs.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication on the agent-facing MCP Gateway. No principal attribution in audit logs.
findings.recommendation: Add an IAM or Lambda authorizer to the AgentCore Gateway that validates caller identity and propagates the principal to downstream logs.

findings.title: Non-Idempotent Settlement Writer
findings.description: settlement_writer performs UPDATE + INSERT with no idempotency protection. Duplicate calls create duplicate payment_queue rows and release duplicate payments.
findings.gap: Non-idempotent write operation on a financial transaction. Agent retries or LLM non-determinism will cause duplicate payments.
findings.recommendation: Add a unique constraint on (claim_id) in payment_queue and use INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING or check claim status before writing.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND settlement_writer is non-idempotent
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: settlement_writer performs financial writes (UPDATE claims, INSERT payment_queue) with no idempotency key or unique constraint. Agent retries create duplicate payments.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add unique constraint on (claim_id) in payment_queue
blocker_remediation.target_state: Duplicate settlement_writer calls produce exactly one payment

findings.title: Mutable Audit Logs Without Principal Attribution
findings.description: CloudWatch logs exist with 10-year retention but are mutable, record no authenticated principal (Gateway has no auth), and have no tamper-evident storage. No CloudTrail for API-level auditing.
findings.gap: No immutable, tamper-evident audit trail attributing write operations to specific agent identities.
findings.recommendation: Export CloudWatch logs to S3 with Object Lock. Add CloudTrail. Include principal identity from Gateway auth in every log entry.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND audit logs are mutable without principal attribution
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agent settles claims and releases payments. Audit logs do not record which agent or user initiated the action, and logs can be deleted.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback for Settlements
findings.description: settlement_writer commits immediately with no compensation or undo mechanism. Batch mode processes up to 500 claims with manual-only rollback.
findings.gap: No automated compensation or rollback for agent-initiated write operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement two-phase settlement: write with status PENDING_SETTLEMENT, then a separate confirmation step. Add automated reversal endpoint.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no compensation exists for financial writes
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: settlement_writer commits settlements and releases payments with no undo. Batch mode processes 500 claims with manual-only rollback per docs/batch-mode.md.

findings.title: Sensitive PII Returned Unfiltered in Tool Responses
findings.description: Agent-facing tool responses return sensitive PII unfiltered: load_claim returns claimant_ssn, payment_history returns routing_no and account_last4. No access control differentiation. No data classification metadata.
findings.gap: B1: Agent-facing APIs return PII/financial data (SSN, bank routing numbers) unfiltered. B2: No access control differentiation. B3: No classification metadata.
findings.recommendation: Remove claimant_ssn from load_claim response. Remove routing_no from payment_history. Create separately-authorized endpoints for sensitive field access.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fired (sensitive fields unfiltered in API responses)
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: load_claim returns claimant_ssn in every response. payment_history returns routing_no. These fields are sent to the LLM in the prompt, stored in memory, and logged to CloudWatch — all unnecessary for the triage decision.

b1.reasoning: claimant_ssn and routing_no returned in general tool responses with no filtering

b2.reasoning: No access control at all — Gateway AuthorizerType NONE, all tools exposed to all callers

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata, no PII annotations, no Macie integration

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls for Regulated PII
findings.description: Regulated PII (SSN, financial data) transmitted to Bedrock model with no explicit residency controls. MODEL_ID configurable via env var. Memory stores raw PII. No SCPs, VPC endpoints, or compliance documentation.
findings.gap: No documented or enforced data residency controls for regulated PII transmitted to LLM and stored in memory.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Add VPC endpoints for Bedrock. Add SCP preventing cross-region invocations. Restrict MODEL_ID to approved in-region models.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND regulated PII has no residency enforcement
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: System transmits SSN, financial data, and bank routing numbers to Bedrock model. MODEL_ID is configurable and could be changed to cross-region. No VPC endpoint or SCP enforces in-region processing.

findings.title: All IAM Policies Use Wildcard Resources
findings.description: All IAM policy statements use Resource: '*'. Single shared role (claims-agent-execution) for Runtime and Lambda. A tool compromise gets model and memory permissions.
findings.gap: No mechanism to scope agent permissions. All permissions wildcard. Single shared role across components.
findings.recommendation: Split into separate roles per component. Replace Resource: '*' with specific resource ARNs.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization on Tools
findings.description: All tools exposed to all callers without filtering. settlement_writer (moves money) accessible to same callers as policy_lookup (read-only). No per-caller tool allow-list.
findings.gap: Cannot restrict agents to read-only tools. No mechanism to differentiate read vs write access.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller tool allow-list in Gateway configuration. Separate read-only tools from write tools.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation — Unverified actor_id
findings.description: No identity propagation. Gateway is unauthenticated so no identity to propagate. actor_id defaults to 'adjuster-pool' — an unverified caller-supplied string.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user. No verified identity flow.
findings.recommendation: Propagate authenticated principal from Gateway authorizer as actor_id. Reject mismatched identities.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend individual agent identities. Gateway unauthenticated. Runtime accepts any account principal. Only option is deleting entire stack.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without taking down the entire platform.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-identity revocation after adding Gateway authentication.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls on Settlements
findings.description: No optimistic locking, version fields, or SELECT FOR UPDATE. settlement_writer performs bare UPDATE/INSERT with no conflict detection.
findings.gap: Race conditions possible under concurrent agent instances. Same claim can be settled multiple times.
findings.recommendation: Add WHERE status = 'OPEN' condition to UPDATE. Verify rows affected = 1 before INSERT.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configuration on any of 5 external dependencies (Bedrock, SecretsManager, PostgreSQL, Knowledge Base, Memory).
findings.gap: Single dependency failure cascades through entire triage operation. No resilience patterns.
findings.recommendation: Configure explicit timeouts on all clients. Add retry with exponential backoff. Consider circuit breaker for database.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Gateway or Runtime
findings.description: No rate limiting or throttling configured. PUBLIC network mode with no traffic controls. No WAF, no API Gateway usage plan, no application-level throttling.
findings.gap: No protection against agent traffic storms or runaway loops.
findings.recommendation: Add WAF rate rule or API Gateway throttling to the Gateway. Configure per-caller limits.

findings.title: No Transaction Limits — Unbounded Blast Radius
findings.description: No dollar ceiling on settlements. No per-run claim count limit. Batch mode bypasses UI threshold. Agent can settle unlimited amounts with no cap.
findings.gap: Unbounded blast radius. No dollar ceiling, no claim count limit, no per-session caps.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable limits: max settlement amount, max settlements per run, max spend per hour. Enforce in tool code.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State for Settlements
findings.description: settlement_writer commits directly to SETTLED status and releases payment immediately. No intermediate state for human review. Batch mode has no approval step.
findings.gap: No reviewable intermediate state. All writes immediately committed and payment released.
findings.recommendation: Implement PENDING_REVIEW status. Separate settlement recommendation from settlement execution.

findings.title: Approval Gates Exist Only in UI — Bypassed by Batch
findings.description: Auto-approve threshold check exists only in adjuster UI. Batch mode bypasses all approvals. No configurable operation-level approval flags in application code.
findings.gap: No application-layer approval gates. Safety checks are UI-only and bypassed by programmatic access.
findings.recommendation: Move auto-approve threshold into settlement_writer. Route high-value settlements to human review queue.

findings.title: PII Logged Unredacted with 10-Year Retention
findings.description: agent.py logs full prompts and completions including claimant SSNs, bank routing numbers, and financial data. CloudWatch retention is 10 years. No redaction, no data-protection policy.
findings.gap: PII (SSN, bank routing numbers, financial data) logged unredacted with long retention.
findings.recommendation: Add PII redaction to logging pipeline. Mask SSN and bank number patterns. Add data-protection policy to log group.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, or Smithy specification. Tool schemas advertised to model have empty inputSchema with no parameter documentation.
findings.gap: No machine-readable spec. Agent tool generation requires manual work.
findings.recommendation: Define complete JSON schemas for tool inputs in _tool_specs(). Consider generating MCP tool manifest.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No error handling in tool functions. Null results crash with TypeError. No error codes, retryable indicators, or consistent error format.
findings.gap: No structured error responses. Agent cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Add try/except wrappers returning structured error dicts with code, message, and retryable fields.

findings.title: No Async Pattern for Long-Running Operations
findings.description: All operations synchronous. Lambda timeout 60s. Batch mode processes 500 claims sequentially with no job status API or polling.
findings.gap: No async support for potentially long-running operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement job submission pattern for batch mode with status polling endpoint.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No staging environment configuration. No docker-compose, no seed data, no synthetic data generators. Tests are fully mocked.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create staging environment with synthetic claims data and docker-compose for local development.

findings.title: Unbounded Results from payment_history
findings.description: payment_history returns all payments for a policy with no LIMIT, pagination, or filtering. Could overwhelm LLM context window.
findings.gap: Unbounded result set from payment_history. No pagination parameters.
findings.recommendation: Add LIMIT and OFFSET parameters. Default to recent N payments.

findings.title: No Input Validation Beyond Parameterized SQL
findings.description: No type checking, format validation, or business rule enforcement on tool inputs. Parameterized queries prevent injection but don't validate business logic.
findings.gap: No systematic validation at API boundary. No business rule enforcement.
findings.recommendation: Add type, format, and business rule validation (e.g., amount > 0, claim_id format check).

findings.title: Incomplete Temporal Metadata
findings.description: Minimal timestamps. Claims lack created_at/updated_at. Memory events have null timestamps. No freshness signaling.
findings.gap: Incomplete temporal metadata on claims. No freshness signaling mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Add timestamps to claims queries. Pass actual timestamps to memory. Add freshness indicators.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or Contract Testing
findings.description: No versioned schemas, no OpenAPI spec, no breaking change detection, no CI pipeline. Tool schemas have empty properties.
findings.gap: Tool interface changes break agent bindings silently. No contract enforcement.
findings.recommendation: Define versioned JSON schemas for tools. Add contract tests. Integrate into CI.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No X-Ray or OpenTelemetry. Plain text logging format. No correlation IDs. Cannot reconstruct end-to-end agent sessions.
findings.gap: Cannot reconstruct agent sessions across Gateway, Runtime, and Memory.
findings.recommendation: Add OpenTelemetry instrumentation. Switch to JSON logging. Add correlation_id field.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms for error rates, latency, or anomalies. Only a log group exists. Agent degradation goes undetected.
findings.gap: No alerting on agent-facing surface. Degradation undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for Lambda errors, duration, Bedrock failures, and DB connection failures.

findings.title: IaC Exists but Lacks Review and Drift Detection
findings.description: CloudFormation templates define infrastructure but no peer review enforcement, no drift detection, and deploy role accessible without MFA.
findings.gap: Missing review requirements and drift detection on IaC changes.
findings.recommendation: Add branch protection for infra/ changes. Enable AWS Config drift detection. Require MFA on deploy role.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline or Contract Testing
findings.description: No CI/CD configuration in repository. No contract tests. Releases promoted on unit tests only. No pre-deployment safety evaluation.
findings.gap: No automated pipeline. No contract validation before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with contract tests and safety evaluation gate.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability — Mutable Container Tag
findings.description: No blue/green, canary, or automatic rollback. Container image referenced as :latest in IaC (mutable tag).
findings.gap: No automated rollback. Mutable container tag prevents reliable version pinning.
findings.recommendation: Pin container to immutable digest. Implement blue/green with rollback triggers.

findings.title: Minimal Test Coverage — Happy Path Only
findings.description: 2 unit tests (happy path, mocked DB). No error cases, adversarial inputs, integration tests, or contract tests. Not connected to CI.
findings.gap: Insufficient test coverage for agent-facing tools.
findings.recommendation: Add error, edge case, and integration tests. Connect to CI pipeline.

findings.title: No Explicit Encryption at Rest Configuration
findings.description: No KMS keys in IaC. Log group storing PII has no explicit encryption. Relies on service defaults.
findings.gap: No explicit encryption at rest for PII data stores.
findings.recommendation: Add customer-managed KMS keys for log group and data stores.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event publishing on settlement or payment release. No SNS/EventBridge integration. Downstream systems must poll database.
findings.gap: State changes not externally observable without DB polling.
findings.recommendation: Publish settlement events to EventBridge.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation or response headers on the Gateway. Agents cannot self-throttle.
findings.gap: No visibility into traffic limits for agent callers.
findings.recommendation: Add X-RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After headers when throttling is implemented.

findings.title: No Data Quality Metrics
findings.description: No data quality metrics, profiling, or completeness monitoring for claims data or knowledge base corpus.
findings.gap: No awareness of data completeness or quality.
findings.recommendation: Add data profiling. Establish freshness SLA for knowledge base ingestion.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, Glue catalog, or data dictionary. Schema only implicit from SQL queries in tools.py.
findings.gap: Data model undocumented beyond source code.
findings.recommendation: Document claims database schema in structured format.

findings.title: No Business Outcome Metrics
findings.description: No custom CloudWatch metrics for settlement rates, amounts, accuracy, or throughput. Cannot measure agent recommendation quality.
findings.gap: Cannot detect systematic over- or under-settlement.
findings.recommendation: Publish settlement metrics. Create agent quality dashboard.

evaluations.title: Documented API Interface
evaluations.reason: System exposes documented MCP tool interface via AgentCore Gateway with REGISTRY-defined tools.

evaluations.title: Structured Response Format
evaluations.reason: All tools return structured JSON-serializable dicts. Agent loop serializes with json.dumps.

evaluations.title: Credential Management
evaluations.reason: Database credentials managed through AWS Secrets Manager. KB_ID in SSM Parameter Store. No hardcoded credentials.

evaluations.title: Queryable Current State
evaluations.reason: load_claim and policy_lookup provide queryable current state via database queries.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service is not P0 priority and not confirmed on critical path.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: All field names are human-readable and semantically meaningful (claim_id, claimant_name, coverage_limit, etc.).

items.summary: Resolve all 6 BLOCKERs (identity, idempotency, audit, rollback, data scoping, residency) and address critical RISK-SAFETY findings to enable scoped pilot evaluation.
Address remaining RISK-QUALITY findings to improve agent effectiveness: structured errors, observability, schema contracts, and deployment maturity.
Implement INFO-level improvements: event emission, rate limit headers, data quality metrics, catalog, business metrics, expanded test coverage.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy Gateway Authentication and Identity Framework
recommended_actions.rationale: Identity is the foundation — scoped permissions, audit logging, tool allow-lists, and suspension all depend on authenticated principals at the Gateway.
Remove PII from tool responses, add data residency enforcement, and implement log redaction to address 3 findings including 2 BLOCKERs.
settlement_writer needs idempotency, compensation, concurrency controls, transaction limits, and approval gates to safely handle financial operations.
Add distributed tracing, alerting, circuit breakers, and rate limiting to make the system debuggable and resilient under agent load.
Build deployment pipeline with contract testing, rollback capability, and expanded test coverage to prevent agent-breaking changes.
